name: lsp_rust
description: Least-privilege lsp tool against rust-analyzer on the Gents workspace. Not a CI gate.
default_prompt:
This workspace is the Gents repository. Use the lsp tool and do not guess types or comments.

1. Call lsp action=hover on crates/gents/src/toolset/shared/command.rs with symbol=meet. Quote the documented rank order.
2. Call lsp action=hover on crates/gents/src/toolset/lsp/auth.rs with symbol=lsp_advertised. Quote the signature.

Quote the hover text. Reply DONE.
